posts.title: Leaked Document Suggests Cellebrite Can Wirelessly Exploit iPhones
posts.custom_excerpt: A user on a blog post claims to have been sent a leaked Cellebrite document marked "confidential" explaining their new capabilities, including exfiltrating data from iPhones using a dedicated device from a range of 8 meters.

authors.name: Fria Reyes
authors.bio: Fria is a privacy advocate and synthwave enthusiast who has been volunteering with Privacy Guides since 2023. They are an unapologetic tech optimist, and believes with the right technology we can solve any problem.
